svg.title: Sliding window on abcabcbb
svg.desc: Eight steps showing the left and right pointers moving across the string abcabcbb. Right moves one step each time. Left jumps forward past a repeated character and never moves back. The longest window without repeats has length 3.

g.text: Longest substring without repeating characters. left only moves forward.

g.text: right visits each index once and left only moves forward, so time is O(n)
Space is O(k) for the last_seen dictionary
